name: ozon_product_chromium
description: MEASURED 2026-09-17 (research/preset_audit_post_merge_2026_09_17.json, n=2 per twin): this engine still WALLED (0 of 2, HTTP 403 on every attempt, ~100 s over three); the camoufox twin (ozon_product_camoufox) 2 of 2 -- but both on the documented SOLD-OUT path: the fixture product 3972904544 has been delisted, Ozon redirected the id URL to a name search on the first attempt, and the recipe returned title + price_last 147221 + out_of_stock='webOutOfStock' with price/rating/sku null as designed. The in-stock path (price 208646 / card 193812 / rating 5.0 / sku on 09-06) is no longer measurable with this id; pick a fresh one for the next measurement. Ozon.ru product page (Russia), by numeric product id: /product/{product_id}/ redirects to the canonical slug URL (measured 2026-09-06, HTTP 200 on both the id and the slug form). A product that has just SOLD OUT is served differently: Ozon redirects the id URL to a search for the product's name (`/search/?deny_category_prediction=true&from_global=true&text=…`, "Товар закончился") whose `webOutOfStock` widget carries the name and the last price -- the recipe reads `title` from that widget when the heading is absent, `price_last` from it, `price` stays null and `out_of_stock` is set; `wait_for_selector` accepts either widget so the sold-out page returns on the first attempt. Selectors anchor on Ozon's `data-widget` names (webProductHeading, webPrice, webSingleProductScore, webDetailSKU), the one thing that survives its hashed-class releases; self_heal is on. Ozon renders TWO prices: `price` is the ordinary one ("С другими банками", tsHeadline500Medium) and `price_ozon_card` the Ozon-card price ("С банками", tsHeadline600Large); both carry Ozon's U+2009 thin-space thousands grouping, which parse_price reads. A product without an Ozon-card discount was NOT captured: on such a page the only price may sit in tsHeadline600Large, which this recipe would report as `price_ozon_card` with `price` null -- read the pair together. `rating` and `review_count` come from the score widget's "5 • 3 отзыва" text; `out_of_stock` is "webOutOfStock" when Ozon renders that widget and null otherwise (the widget's own data-widget attribute, measured on the sold-out capture of 2026-09-06). The antibot challenge is passed by the homepage warmup, as on ozon_search. ENGINE: Chromium (real Chrome, headful). MEASURED 2026-09-06: WALLED -- as shipped, 0 of 2 runs (HTTP 403 on every attempt, research/preset_audit_new_bases_2026_09_06.json), the same verdict as ozon_search_chromium. Use ozon_product_camoufox for data; this twin exists so the pair stays measurable. timeout_ms 31000 (per-phase, with the 10 s warmup dwell; see test_builtin_timeout_fits_the_first_attempt).
